risks.title: Market risk and price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to fluctuations in electricity and natural gas prices in wholesale markets. While prices increased in 2025 ($60.30/MWh vs $40.91/MWh in 2024), significant declines could compromise profitability. Strong dependence on weather conditions and demand creates seasonal volatility.

risks.title: Regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations on PJM capacity markets and grid reliability requirements. Changes to PJM rules concerning seller offer caps or reserve margins could impact capacity revenues.

risks.title: Credit and liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company completed two major acquisitions in 2025-2026 (Freedom/Guernsey for $3.8 billion and Cornerstone for $3.45 billion) and significantly increased debt. Issuance of $2.7 billion in unsecured senior notes and additional financing could compromise financial flexibility.

risks.title: Acquisition integration risk
risks.score_rationale: The Cornerstone acquisition of 2.5 GW adds substantial natural gas generation capacity in the western PJM market. Integration of these complex assets and expected operational synergies carry operational and financial risks.

risks.title: Environmental and nuclear risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates Susquehanna nuclear facility which benefits from the nuclear tax credit (up to $15/MWh). Any nuclear accident, policy change, or failure to meet prevailing wage requirements could impact revenues and reputation.

risks.title: Capital concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: The four largest shareholders of TEC collectively hold approximately 33% of outstanding common shares, which could affect shareholder votes on mergers and other significant transactions.
